description: Retrieve a previously stored ciphertext. Requires the namespace_token. Costs $0.02 in USDC on Base, paid via the x402 protocol, or from a credit token — call credits_trial for free credit if you have neither.

credit_token.description: Optional. A credit token from credits_trial or /credits/buy. Supplying it pays for this call from that balance, so no x402 payment or wallet is needed.

namespace_token.description: One-time token issued by the first call that claimed this namespace. Required for every later call.

name: vault_retrieve

alg.description: Algorithm label you supplied at store time

ciphertext.description: Exactly the bytes you stored. Decrypt these yourself.

expires_at.description: Expiry, or null if it never expires

title: Retrieve an encrypted secret
